title: When Are Both Roots Integers? x² + bx + 12b | AMC 10-Style Level 4
description:
For how many integers b does x² + bx + 12b = 0 have two integer roots? Vantee turns the roots into a sum and a product, then uses a clever factoring trick to turn the whole question into factor pairs of 144. You'll see a second way that chases just one root, why 8, 15, 30 and 32 are traps, and a new equation to try yourself.
